title: The Memory Inside the Recipe Card
youtube_title: The Memory Inside the Recipe Card | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: The best answer sometimes starts with hearing the whole thing.
summary: At a bedroom at lamp time, story not started yet, Auntie Luz begins to tell Kei about memory written on the back of a recipe card. Kei wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
